nodes.label: E2E Folder Map
nodes.rationale: The suite is split by responsibility (tests, fixtures, pages, components, helpers, api, interfaces, testdata) so a contributor can locate the right layer without reading the whole tree.

nodes.label: tests/ - Test Entrypoints by PMM Area
nodes.norm_label: tests/ - test entrypoints by pmm area

nodes.label: pages/ - PMM and Grafana Page Objects
nodes.norm_label: pages/ - pmm and grafana page objects

nodes.label: helpers/ - Shared API, Auth, CLI, k8s and Metrics Helpers
nodes.norm_label: helpers/ - shared api, auth, cli, k8s and metrics helpers

nodes.label: api/ - API Clients for UI and API Tests
nodes.norm_label: api/ - api clients for ui and api tests

nodes.label: pmmTest Fixture
nodes.rationale: Tests import a single shared entrypoint (@fixtures/pmmTest) instead of raw Playwright test, so auth and PMM-specific setup are applied uniformly.

nodes.label: Shared Timeout Values (@helpers/timeouts)
nodes.rationale: Timeouts are centralised so waits stay consistent across the suite rather than being hand-tuned per test.

nodes.label: .env Runtime Configuration
nodes.rationale: Environment-specific values live in an untracked .env so the same suite can target localhost, CI, or an ad-hoc PMM server without code changes.

nodes.label: @pmm-ha Tagged Suite
nodes.rationale: HA tests need cluster access that ordinary runs do not, so they are isolated behind a tag rather than gated at runtime.

nodes.label: KUBECONFIG Pointing at the PMM HA Cluster
nodes.norm_label: kubeconfig pointing at the pmm ha cluster

nodes.label: Default 'pmm' Kubernetes Namespace
nodes.rationale: The namespace default is held in the K8sHelper constructor rather than an env var; overriding means editing the constructor or passing one in.

nodes.label: Fail Loud, Never Self-Skip
nodes.rationale: An unreachable namespace surfaces kubectl's own error as a test failure instead of a silent skip, so a broken HA environment cannot masquerade as a green run.

nodes.label: Playwright Runtime Defaults
nodes.rationale: Chromium-only, fully parallel, 10-minute test / 30-minute global timeouts, 1920x1080 viewport, and 2 retries only in CI - failure artifacts (screenshots, traces) are captured on failure so passing runs stay cheap.

nodes.label: E2E Tag Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: The tag list sits between E2E-TAGS-START/END markers, indicating it is regenerated from the tests rather than maintained by hand.
